title: N.K. official's Beijing visit meant to share Chinese party meeting results, maintain high-level exchanges: Seoul
caption:
North Korea’s senior party official flew to Beijing right after China’s key party meeting, meeting top officials. Seoul says the trip was about sharing those results and keeping dialogue alive, hinting at a tighter strategic bond, though no concrete agreements were announced yet.
